review: All six upstream inputs read completely; root MIT applies with no additional file notices. Preserve full notices; public vendor inputs unchanged.

Original clock parent retained unchanged for provenance, never staged runnable. Exact readonly-clock-v1 extraction removes calendar Loader and all calendar forwarding, IPC, refresh, persistence and pointer actions before preparation. Original format/ISO-week/time logic, SystemClock and WidgetButton/OpticalGlyph presentation retained.
WidgetButton and OpticalGlyph unchanged. No registration API; tooltip compatibility callbacks are explicitly inert. Parent/button pointer input disabled; no timezone action or shell.run route.

Commons has only authored passive Style/Color/I18n, no original singleton, watcher, process, catalog or font asset. Fixed palette and 12px monospace remain diagnostic adaptations. Panel labels and the clock format locale use the pinned English catalog: en-US. This is not full theme or locale-file loading.

TrialShell defaults denied; exact finite grant before its fixed panel URL; sticky revoke on input change. No arbitrary QML/path/catalog/command. The panel uses pinned Quickshell Variants.model so each connected screen gets one non-focusable bar. A visible Wayland trial stays separately approved; production catalog remains empty.

Clock calendar is a separate derivation (clock-calendar-v1 and clock-calendar-host-v1) of the pinned Panel.qml and BarWidget.qml. The sealed ClockLabel stays read-only. The live trial opens the original month grid. Shell IPC, the timezone helper, and configuration writes are not admitted; week start, label format, and birth year stay in session memory.

Elsewhen is a derived original panel (Jason Fried, MIT) on centerEnd. Cities stay in the process. Weather fetch, GitHub profiles, notifications and system timezone changes are excluded. Offsets use the read-only helper.

Plan 078: all mapped source parents checked against Omarchy v4.5.0 stable Git blobs. Changed parents and new WallClock reviewed; complete MIT notices unchanged. Original source bytes remain unmodified. The shared Style easing curve comes from stable Commons/Style.qml. Updated transforms retain Ubuntu backend and no-Exclusive-focus boundaries. Weather IP discovery continues through wttr.in, not the new upstream geo endpoint.
limits: Authored frame, not original Bar.qml. The sealed preview label stays read-only. The live trial calendar is the derived original popup without IPC, configuration writes, or the privileged timezone picker.
Checker uses established Bubblewrap isolation; private software offscreen QtQuick Window only, no host display/compositor/GPU/network/buses.
No real Wayland start, desktop configuration/service replacement, deployment, authentication, lock/idle/suspend, packages, privilege or publication acceptance.

Plan 078 is source-component alignment only, not full-shell, pixel, native or next-login acceptance. Original registry, widget drag persistence, notification/idle/lock services, new external endpoints and provisioning stay excluded. Session-lifetime components do not acquire a timeout; timed diagnostics remain explicit.
